title: Unknown: audio telemetry missing
instructions: The same silent bot and the same wallhack stand-in, but the server's audio query is switched off.

card.what_this_tests: Missing telemetry does not mean absent information.
card.player_can_know: Nobody checked whether they could hear it, so fpsdet cannot say they could not.
card.server_knows: Vision absent. Audio unchecked: the query did not run, and the server says so instead of saying absent. It cannot measure hidden time either, so it sends none.
card.expected_fpsdet_behavior: KnowledgeState unknown. The hidden-mover check abstains (telemetry_unavailable). No evidence, whatever the aim did.
card.invalid_if: A server reports unchecked as absent. That manufactures the previous scenario's review from nothing.

caveats: Unchecked is not absent. A channel the server did not report makes the answer unknown, and the information checks abstain.
